jobs.title: Head of Engineering, ML, Forma Generative AI
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101528

Position Overview

Autodesk is transforming how the AEC industry designs and builds through integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) across its products, including AutoCAD, Revit, and Forma.

As Head of Engineering, ML for Forma Generative AI, you will lead the ML Engineering organization responsible for computational design and data representations, applied ML model development, and ML infrastructure and operations. You will lead through three engineering managers, setting the ML strategy for the team, defining the technical and organizational standards across the discipline, and shaping how teams build, deploy, and operate production ML systems.

You will partner closely with Architecture, Software Engineering, Research, Product, and other senior leaders to define technical direction, resolve cross-organizational trade-offs, and ensure the organization can move from promising ML research to reliable product capabilities at scale.

Report:
You will report to the Director, Forma Generative AI.

Location:
We support hybrid work, and you work near our Toronto, Canada office. This role requires the ability to travel to team meetings, offsites, and conferences in the USA, Canada, and Europe.

Responsibilities

Define and uphold ML engineering strategy, standards, and expectations across the organization, including how ML systems are designed, tested, reviewed, deployed, evaluated, and operated in production
Lead and develop the engineering managers responsible for Computational Design & Data Representations, Applied ML, and ML Infrastructure and Operations. Own the evolution of the ML engineering organization, including team structure, boundaries, hiring, succession, and organizational design
Partner with Architecture and peer engineering leaders to establish shared ML architectures, reusable components, and engineering practices that enable teams to move quickly without compromising quality or consistency
Partner with Research, Product, and Engineering leaders to balance long-term ML research and platform investments with iterative product delivery; align priorities, staffing, and capacity across the ML organization; surface constraints early and resolve cross-team trade-offs to keep critical work moving
Represent ML engineering in organizational planning, resourcing, escalations, and major technical decisions, serving as the discipline’s leadership voice across Forma Generative AI
Build a high-trust engineering culture that develops strong technical leaders, encourages knowledge sharing, and raises the quality of engineering judgement across the organization

Minimum Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience
8+ years of software/ML engineering experience, including 4+ years of engineering management experience and demonstrated experience managing engineering managers or leading multiple engineering teams
Track record building and operating production ML systems at scale across training, deployment, inference, monitoring, and evaluation
Experience establishing engineering standards and technical direction across multiple teams without centralizing every decision
Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining engineering managers and senior technical leads, with strong communication and influence across senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for large-scale ML or foundation-model systems
Deep technical familiarity with modern ML engineering and production infrastructure, including ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), distributed training and inference, cloud infrastructure, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, and production automation
Experience designing or leading development of foundation-model and agentic systems, including evaluation harnesses, tool-use/orchestration patterns, and other production scaffolding around models
Experience partnering with peer engineering, architecture, research, and product leaders in a matrixed organization
Experience in the AEC industry, Autodesk products, or another technically complex design/engineering domain
Experience applying rapidly evolving foundation-model and agentic-system technologies in production environments

The Ideal Candidate

You know the difference between managing a team and leading an organization; you develop strong managers, create clear ownership, and scale through others
You can establish a technical bar and make it stick through standards, coaching, and strong engineering judgement rather than personal gatekeeping
You build trust with senior peers across architecture, research, product, and engineering, and can navigate disagreement and ambiguity while keeping the organization moving
You communicate effectively across disciplines and levels, adapting your approach to build shared understanding with technical, product, research, and executive audiences

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $156,000 and $228,800. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Lead the global capital strategy for a newly public, high-growth technology company at a pivotal stage of expansion. Bring your investor network and capital-markets expertise to drive transformational financing, strategic partnerships, and M&A opportunities. Partner directly with the Founder, Board, and Senior Executive team in a highly visible CFO role with significant influence, upside, and equity participation. Home base of either Toronto
is strongly preferred.

Who- the Company:

Swim Recruiting is conducting a confidential search on behalf of an AI and media technology company operating across Canada, the United States, and various countries in Europe.

The company delivers in an integrated solution with one connected platform. They are not selling new hardware, they are not pushing a major system change. They are taking data and intelligence that customers often already have, and strategically connecting the information to monetize real results. So far the company has over 50 clients in 4+ countries and their product is being used in thousands of locations. Following a recent reverse takeover and stock exchange listing, the organization has entered its next phase of growth: scaling their proven platform into new markets and verticals while continuing to build the capital markets profile of a public growth company.

What- the Role:

Swim Recruiting has been engaged on the search for a new Global Chief Financial Officer
whose first priority is capital markets: raising capital for a TSXV growth company and keeping the market informed and engaged once it is raised. It suits a capital markets professional who has led small-cap raises as a CFO, VP Finance, or corporate development lead and is ready to own the full mandate.

The CFO will run financings from term sheet to close, starting with private placements, bridge financing and working capital facilities, and growing into larger equity and debt rounds as the company scales. Working alongside the Founder & CEO and the Global COO, the CFO will be a primary face of the company to brokers, investors, and lenders and will play a key role in translating the growth story into funding.

This is not a back-office finance role. We are looking for an externally-facing CFO who already grown a public company and who arrives with an active network of institutional investors, private credit and structured finance providers, investment bankers, and strategic partners ready to engage with.

This is a rare opportunity to be the architect of the capital strategy for a newly public, fast-scaling technology company.

What- the Responsibilities:

Capital Markets & Fundraising
Lead brokered and non-brokered private placements, convertibles, and warrant structures from mandate through to close
Secure and manage bridge, working capital, and asset-based facilities, including LC and credit lines tied to inventory and deployment cycles
Build and work a pipeline of Canadian investment dealers, family offices, high-net-worth and institutional investors, and private lenders
Prepare the materials that win capital: investor decks, financial models, data rooms, and term sheet analysis
Run investor meetings, non-deal roadshows, and conferences in Canada and the US

Investor Relations & Disclosure
Own investor relations for a TSXV-listed company: shareholders, analysts, market makers, and IR firms
Prepare news releases, MD&A, and financing disclosure in coordination with securities counsel
Ensure every financing is structured, approved, and filed in compliance with TSXV policies and Canadian securities requirements

Capital Strategy
Build and maintain a 12 to 24 month funding roadmap that balances dilution, cost of capital, and growth speed
Advise the Founder & Chairman, Global COO, and Board on capital structure and on financing for strategic or M&A opportunities

Finance Oversight
Oversee reporting, treasury, and controls with country finance leads across Canada, the US, Europe, and Turkey, to public company standards
Present to the Board and Audit Committee on cash position, runway, and funding plans

Who- The Candidate:

10+ years in finance
, with at least 5 in Canadian capital markets as a public company CFO or VP Finance, in corporate development, or in investment banking or equity capital markets at a Canadian dealer
A track record of personally leading small-cap raises
on the TSXV, CSE, or TSX, typically C$2M to C$30M per round (we will ask about the amount, structure, and your role in each)
A current network
of Canadian investment dealers, family offices, high-net-worth investors, and private lenders you can put to work in your first 90 days. This network is a requirement of the role, not a nice-to-have.
Working knowledge of TSXV policies, NI 45-106 prospectus exemptions, continuous disclosure, and IFRS and current PIFF
CPA, CFA, or equivalent designation
Comfortable operating at both altitudes — the strategic capital-raising mandate and enough command of the underlying financials to be credible with investors, lenders, and the Board.
Experience in technology, AI/analytics, media, or adjacent sectors is highly preferred, almost required.. however we will consider CFOs with highly relevant work experience and networks who perhaps haven’t yet worked in this space.
Willingness to travel regularly across the company's markets in North America, UK, and Europe.

How Much:

The new CFO will receive a base salary commensurate with depth and breadth of work experience and relevant of investor networks, in the range of $240,000 to $300,000 Canadian
. The upside
for this role
is robust
. The CFO will be eligible for an annual bonus program and equity. The CEO/Founder will have their CFO’s total earnings increase in-step with the company’s growth. We are looking for a CFO who thrives on having “skin in the game”, and who is highly motivated by the potential rewards of their sweat equity, corporate finance savvy, and successful capital raising activities.

Where:

Home base of Greater Toronto Area, with frequent business travel across North America, as well occasional trips to the UK, Europe, and potentially Asia. Must have a valid passport and no travel restrictions.

When & How to Apply:

Swim Recruiting will be conducting initial screening and interviewing, and presenting the resumes and profiles of short-listed candidates directly to the hiring team. If you are interested in this opportunity so far and would like to hear more, please hit “ APPLY
” and a Recruitment Consultant at SWIM will reach out if there is a potential for a match. Thank you!
